scope: Selected exact cached workbook values exported by the source acquisition workflow; not invented individual data. Full source files available from publisher links and workflow artifacts. Farhy5 is aggregate; Farhy6 filtered published DEG tables.

rows.C1: Differences in mRNA expression between wt and ko in Ip3r2KO model as indicated - full statistical analysis. Averages, and analysis calculated for N=5, i.e. per mouse

rows.A4: Comparison between genotypes within each layer
rows.J4: Comparison between genotypes within each layer

rows.A1: This workbook contains data from p9-p11 TMEM16A KO mice and WT mice used to reconstruct MNTB input maps and MNTB input widths as shown in the MS "The Cl--channel TMEM16A controls the generation of cochlear Ca2+ waves and promotes the refinement of auditory brainstem networks" by A. Maul et al.

rows.A3: Worksheet "Input Map" contains data shown in Figure 5. Column B and C contain the MNTB input area analyzed from wildtype and TMEM16A mice, respectively. Each line in column B represents data obtained from one mouse examined (n=10 WT mice and n=10 cKO mice).

rows.A4: Worksheet "Input Width" contains data shown in Figure 5. Column B and C contain the MNTB input width analyzed from wildtype and TMEM16A mice, respectively. Each line in column B represents data obtained from one mouse examined (n=10 WT mice and n=10 cKO mice; same mice as for analysis of input maps).

rows.A5: *Exemplary MNTBs shown in Figure 5A are highlighted in yellow.

genes.D1: Complete list of differentially expressed genes between WT and KO for each model, VGlut2, and Ip3r2 as indicated. Up and downregulated genes are shown.

genes.C1: Complete list of genes common to KO/WT DEGs and developmentally regulated genes identified in Ribotag RNAseq (Figure 1) for each model.

genes.A2: Common genes developmentally regulated, with neuronal and astrocyte activity DEGs
